limitations: Production dist with development Electron host; synthetic settled history and injected input. Online fonts and contention affect timings. CPU/Chromium tracing adds overhead and an initial blank navigation; compare separately from unprofiled repetitions. Event Timing is quantized to 8ms and thresholded at 16ms; reported interaction tails exclude faster interactions and are not INP. Presentation delay is the Event Timing estimate, not physical display latency. Input-to-RAF remains a separate proxy. No provider execution, live replay, or release-quality tail estimates.
attributionNote: CPU summaries reprocessed from original profiles with recursive-inclusive de-duplication and hidden source maps. CPU source locations refer to each recorded variant. Raw CPU/Chromium files are in startup-profiles.zip.
